displayName: Data sharing between work and personal profile
description: Choose if data can be shared between work and personal profiles. Available for corporate-owned work profile devices.

options.description: Not configured; this value defaults to CROSS_PROFILE_DATA_SHARING_UNSPECIFIED.
Data cannot be shared from both the personal profile to work profile and the work profile to the personal profile.

options.displayName: Block sharing from work to personal profile
options.description: Prevents users from sharing data from the work profile to apps in the personal profile. Personal data can be shared with work apps.
Data from either profile can be shared with the other profile.
